web.$description: Web scope: websites, landing pages, marketing pages and documentation. Values here exist only for web pages; everything else comes from shared.

sheet.$description: Max width of the landing sheet.

page.$description: Max width of a documentation page.

hero.$description: Hero title on landing pages. Scales down with clamp() to font.size.700.

sub.$description: Hero sub-paragraph on landing pages. Sits between font.size.300 (body) and font.size.400 (lead).

specimen.$description: Large type specimen (Aa) on landing pages.
